description: This file declares the KmlParser class responsible for parsing .kml files to extract GPS fixes, providing static methods for parsing files and strings, and referencing external GPS fix structures.

classes.name: KmlParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods for parsing KML files and strings to extract GPS fixes.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses a specified .kml file to extract GPS fixes into the provided array. Returns true on success.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses a string containing KML data to extract GPS fixes into the provided array. Returns true on success.
